headline: Aisha understands the intention, roll, wisdom, reflection, and observation loop before she enters the game.
overview: A live product-level walk for Leela Quest · Web, framed around Aisha Karim's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
payoff: Aisha understands the intention, roll, wisdom, reflection, and observation loop before she enters the game.

scenes.title: A journey, not a fortune teller
scenes.narrative: The product frames the board as self-discovery through ancient wisdom and offers native and browser entry points.
frameCaptions: A journey, not a fortune teller
scenes.action: Opened the public Leela Quest introduction.

scenes.title: The full reflection loop is visible
scenes.narrative: Aisha sees that the product begins with her intention, uses the roll to create a prompt, and ends with reflection and observation.
frameCaptions: The full reflection loop is visible

scenes.title: Rules turn symbolism into a usable practice
scenes.narrative: The guide explains how intention, dice, snakes, arrows, and square meanings work together so the ritual is learnable rather than mystical UI.
frameCaptions: Rules turn symbolism into a usable practice

scenes.title: The 72-square board can be studied before a roll
scenes.narrative: The board reference exposes the map and its states outside a live session, giving Aisha context for the guidance she will receive.
frameCaptions: The 72-square board can be studied before a roll

scenes.title: The product hands off to the real game
scenes.narrative: The browser build is the actual Flutter game surface. Native iPhone evidence is published separately so this web handoff is not misrepresented as mobile-app proof.
frameCaptions: The product hands off to the real game
